title: 進路セミナーⅡ
subtitle: Career Planning Seminar II
educationalGoal: In this subject, students consider their career paths by clarifying their work objectives. In order to find their paths, students conduct industry and company research, and undertake self-analysis to understanding their circumstances. In addition, students will acquire basic business and communication skills for job hunting.
advice: This class is provided for 3rd-year students. The overview is as follows: 1. Introduction of career planning 2. Industry and company research 3. Special lecture 1 (Personnel management officer from companies) 4. Special lecture 2 (Personnel management officer from companies) [Three special lectures named as lectures (I), (II), and (III) are listed below] 5. Preparing for job interviews 6. Summary and practical issues Precautions Lectures described above are delivered as special lectures by invited graduates. Students are required to actively participate in class. The special lecture schedule is subject to change. Reference documents and practice problems will be distributed to students as appropriate.
requiredKnowledge: Career Planning Seminars I and II are courses for job hunting, and students will prepare for better employment. Students are supposed to take this course regardless of their advancement to graduate school or to employment. In addition, the material learned in this subject may be used as reference matter for job placement in the next year.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the process of deciding one’s career path. [0.25A]
Be able to collect and analyze necessary information for job hunting. [0.25A]
Be able to explain the level of aptitude and academic ability required by companies. [0.25A]
Be able to interact with companies.[0.25A]

achievementLevels.ideal: Students with ideal achievement acquire the four target abilities. Also, they can judge a company's performance accurately not only from general articles but also from published IR data. In job interviews, they can understand interviewers’ questions accurately and respond quickly according to the situation.
achievementLevels.standard: Student with standard achievement acquire about 75% of the four target abilities. In interviews, they can understand most of the interviewers’ questions and respond in a limited time.
